instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Put back the answered steps of a decision whose case lost them, so the decision reads as answered as far as it was", and give it decision_id (The decision).
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:repair-a-decisions-answered-steps and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Reads a decision of the person's own with every answered step whole and puts right each answered step whose summary has lost its grading: from the step's own record when it is there (a summary written for a step the door could not read), otherwise from the step and summary the case's own earlier refs named for that position, the highest version.

4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: decision (records:read, records:list, records:write); decision-revision (records:read, records:write); decision-step (records:read, records:write); decision-call (records:write); decision-evidence (records:read, records:list, records:write); decision-answered-step (records:read, records:list, records:write); decision-option (records:read, records:list, records:write); decision-candidate (records:read, records:list, records:write); decision-report (records:read, records:list, records:write); decision-carried-out (records:read, records:list, records:write); decision-history (records:read, records:list, records:write); decision-cited-pursuit (records:read, records:list, records:write); decision-method (records:read, records:write); decision-part (records:read, records:write); decision-refs (records:read, records:list, records:write).
